formalTimePath.finding: argparse --short-ms has no non-None default; omitted -> None. New stage required; new run-config writes timeLimitMs:null. Server command only appends --time-limit-ms when short_ms is not None. No --output-dir.
Loads supplied fresh --config; only explicit --time-limit-ms overrides time_limit_ms.
None preserves generated/fixture daySeconds and uses format.parameters().4 as -kind-deadline (60/90/120sec). Same one problem/official server schedule applies all4 teams; shortened=false.
Selection first/semifinal/final60/90/120sec; samples/arena keep original daySeconds; procedural fallback60sec/day. No blanket replacement of arena schedules.
Shortened selection-deadline hint is enabled only if active.shortened. Official run uses normal path.
All4 captured runner hashes match source; PATH/LANG only; bridge args only server/token/solver; no --select-ms or --solver-arg budget options.
No supplied select override; official map-sized selection deadline and actual per-day endsAt. Requests pass remaining wall time minus normal500ms network margin, bounded by original daySeconds.

Coordinator derives deadline from request.time_limit_ms; normal margin5% clamped250..1500ms, peer budget remaining minus150ms; worker accepts budget up to600000ms and uses it as deadline; pool computes actual remaining time. No fixed10sec test cap.
